title: ADP Tester
description:
ADP Tester – Workday to ADP Payroll Transformation

Title: ADP Tester (5–7 Years)

Location: Brazil 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Client: Kyndryl

Overview

We are seeking an experienced ADP Tester to support a large-scale Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation program. The consultant will be responsible for validating end-to-end payroll processing across Workday and ADP (GlobalView / Workforce Now / Celergo), ensuring data accuracy, compliance with payroll rules, and a smooth transition to the new payroll landscape. This role requires strong hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions, deep understanding of gross-to-net calculations, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in HR, Payroll, and IT.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and execute test cases for Workday-to-ADP payroll integrations, including end-to-end payroll cycles.
  • Validate payroll processing results, including earnings, deductions, taxes, and gross-to-net calculations across ADP platforms.
  • Review and validate data mapping and transformations between Workday and ADP (GlobalView, Workforce Now, or Celergo).
  • Test inbound and outbound interface files between Workday and ADP, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to defined formats.
  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for payroll-related processes.
  • Log, track, and document defects using the client’s defect management tools, working with technical and functional teams to drive timely resolution.
  • Support parallel payroll testing cycles by comparing legacy and new payroll results, identifying and analyzing variances.
  • Collaborate closely with Workday configuration teams, ADP SMEs, payroll operations, and project managers to clarify requirements, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain test documentation, including test plans, scripts, scenarios, and status reports.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, and templates for payroll transformation projects.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions.
  • Practical experience with one or more of the following: ADP GlobalView, ADP Celergo, and/or ADP Workforce Now.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll rules, calculations, and end-to-end gross-to-net processing (earnings, deductions, benefits, taxes).
  • Experience testing payroll integrations, including validation of inbound and outbound interface files.
  • Ability to design and execute test cases, analyze results, and document defects in a structured way.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, global environments with HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of Workday payroll configuration and Workday payroll interface (WPI) or similar Workday outbound interfaces.
  • Experience with large-scale payroll transformation or migration projects.
  • Prior experience working with global payroll across multiple countries and legal entities.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and working within structured project frameworks.

Engagement Details

This is a contract position supporting Kyndryl on a Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation initiative. Candidates may be based in the US, Brazil, or India and must be comfortable collaborating with distributed, multicultural teams located in multiple time zones.

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges.   • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.

title: Head Comercial
description:

Fundado em 1982, o Ibiti Projeto surgiu com o objetivo de promover a regeneração ambiental na região. Hoje, cobre uma área com mais de 6.000 hectares onde, além da restauração natural, desenvolve projetos de rewilding com a reintegração da fauna nativa, parcerias com iniciativas ambientais, produção orgânica de alimentos e apoio ao desenvolvimento da comunidade local. Estamos nas montanhas de Minas Gerais.

Dentro do território, contamos com três conceitos de hospedagem:

Ibiti Village: uma típica vila do interior, com 11 acomodações para receber nossos visitantes.

Engenho Lodge: uma grande casa com 8 suítes, e a Casa Carlinhos , uma residência típica de fazenda com 3 suítes.

  • Primeiro hotel B Corp do Brasil – Certificado pela B Lab Global desde 2017
  • Condé Nast Johansens Excellence Award 2024 – Melhor prática de sustentabilidade na América do Sul e Central

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Campaign Manager – Paid Media
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Campaign Manager to lead our paid media strategy across major digital advertising platforms—including YouTube Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and X (Twitter) Ads.


You will be responsible for designing, launching, optimizing, and scaling performance marketing campaigns aimed at sports fans, bettors, and gaming audiences.


This role is ideal for someone who lives and breathes sports, understands betting behavior, and can turn data-driven insights into profitable user acquisition.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Campaign strategy & execution


  • Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns across: Google Search, Google Display, YouTube, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and X .
  • Build segmented acquisition strategies for sports/betting audiences.
  • Set up full-funnel advertising flows (awareness → engagement → conversion).
  • Conduct extensive keyword, audience, and competitor research.


Campaign optimization


  • Continuously optimize campaigns to improve CAC, ROAS, LTV, and conversion rates.
  • Perform A/B testing on creatives, audiences, and landing pages.
  • Monitor and adjust bids, budgets, frequency, and placements daily.


Analytics & reporting


  • Track and analyze performance using Google Analytics, platform dashboards, and internal BI tools .
  • Provide weekly/monthly performance reports with actionable insights.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, pacing, and budget allocation.


Creative & content collaboration


  • Work with designers and content teams to develop high-performing assets (video, static, copy).
  • Brief creative teams with data-backed insights.
  • Ensure all campaigns follow brand, compliance, and regulatory guidelines.


Compliance & industry requirements


  • Ensure all ad creatives and targeting strategies follow advertising regulations across markets.
  • Stay updated on platform policies for gambling/betting advertising.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • 5–7 years of hands-on paid media experience managing multi-channel campaigns.
  • Proven track record scaling campaigns in sports, betting, gaming, or a similar data-driven vertical.
  • Strong command of: Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, X Ads
  • Deep understanding of CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, attribution, and tracking.
  • Experience with GA4, Looker Studio, tracking pixels, UTM strategy, and conversion APIs.
  • Strong analytical mindset with fluency in numbers.
  • Passion for sports and familiarity with betting markets.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English. Spanish is a plus.


Bonus points if you:


  • Experience in regulated markets.
  • Familiarity with affiliate marketing or sportsbook acquisition funnels.
  • Knowledge of SEO, CRM, or retention strategies.
  • Experience working in startups or scaling environments.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You

title: Lead Generation Specialist
description:
The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

About Us

Publicity For Good (PFG) is a U.S.-based public relations firm that partners with purpose-driven, profitability-conscious brands worldwide.

We specialize in working with Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) companies, particularly in the Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty sectors. Our team secures high-impact media placements for clients through top-tier global outlets such as CBS, Fox News, Vogue, and Forbes.

At PFG, we amplify brands that are making a difference. Our focus is on meaningful visibility, measurable results, and long-term growth. We also operate Signal Raptor, a standalone software solution that enhances brand exposure and supports business scaling.


Role


This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.


Responsibilities


  • Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads).
  • Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems.
  • Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics.
  • Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects.
  • Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns.
  • Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns.
  • Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized.
  • Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence.
  • Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows.
  • Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions.
  • Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations.
  • Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings.
  • Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources.
  • Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
  • Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates.
  • Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.


Results


  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets.
  • Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads).
  • Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status.
  • Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context.
  • Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns.
  • Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation.
  • Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality.
  • Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks.
  • Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.


Requirements


  • Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting.
  • Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns.
  • Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs.
  • Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization.
  • Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.


The starting pay for this position is $630 USD.

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior (Prevenção a Fraudes)

Um pouco sobre nós:


A TotalPass é uma empresa que oferece benefícios corporativos para o bem estar, proporcionando acesso à diversos serviços como academias, estúdios especializados em corrida, boxe, yoga, ciclismo, treinos funcionais coletivos e desenvolvimento muscular. Tudo isso para que as pessoas se sintam seguras em um ambiente onde é possível equilibrar o físico e o mental, de acordo com as possibilidades de suas próprias rotinas.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time de Prevenção a fraudes. Será um profissional experiente, apaixonado por descobrir padrões e insights a partir de grandes volumes de dados que gerem valor para o negócio.

O time de Prevenção e Fraude da TotalPass é composto por profissionais altamente qualificados e dedicados a proteger nossos clientes e nossos negócios contra atividades fraudulentas. Trabalhamos de forma colaborativa, utilizando tecnologias de ponta e metodologias avançadas para identificar, analisar e mitigar riscos de fraude. Nosso time é movido por desafios e está constantemente em busca de novas formas de melhorar a segurança e a eficiência de nossas operações.


Como será o seu dia a dia?


  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos estatísticos e algoritmos de machine learning para prever e detectar padrões de fraude com alto grau de precisão e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e implementar segmentações comportamentais baseada em técnicas estatísticas;
  • Construir modelos preditivos que identificam anomalias, comportamentos suspeitos e tendências de fraude com base em dados históricos e em tempo real;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos modelos;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e evoluções na área de prevenção a fraudes e implementar as melhores práticas.


Requisitos:


  • Vasta atuação em Data Science e Machine Learning;
  • Experiência em lidar com grandes volumes de dados e em manipulação de dados em ambientes de nuvem, preferencialmente AWS;
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python, SQL, e experiência com frameworks de Machine Learning;

  • Capacidade de se comunicar de forma colaborativa;


Quais seriam seus diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e experiência em trabalhar em ambientes ágeis;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de painéis de visualização de dados utilizando ferramentas como: Quicksight, Data Viz,Tableau ou PowerBI;

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Engenheiro Mecânico
description:
Mechanical Engineering


Looking for:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position

will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and

bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,

prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all

requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.


The Candidate:

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the

concept to manufacturing journey. You’ve either built or supported bringing new products to the

world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of

materials. You’re willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on

challenges.

The Qualifications :

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE’s.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English


The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.E. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

Este profissional será o ponto central na auditoria, monitoria, controle, qualidade, registro e acompanhamento de contratos comerciais e operacionais, garantindo que todos os documentos sejam formalizados corretamente, lançados nos sistemas internos e acompanhados em seus respectivos fluxos financeiros e jurídicos.

Responsabilidades

  • Auditar e revisar todos os novos contratos firmados, garantindo aderência às políticas e padrões da empresa, a auditoria não se limita somente a analise documental, mas tambem em avaliar as ligações, videos, grações e conversas de whatsapp;
  • Controlar e registrar contratos nos sistemas financeiros e planilhas de gestão, mantendo versionamento e histórico atualizado;
  • Apontar pendências e inconformidades em tempo hábil, sinalizando responsáveis e acompanhando as correções;
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores das auditorias contratuais, apresentando análises e tendências de conformidade;
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de recebíveis derivados dos contratos, acompanhando prazos de faturamento, pagamentos e renovações;
  • Criar e manter gatilhos automáticos e reports recorrentes, com alertas sobre vencimentos, reajustes e obrigações financeiras;
  • Atuar junto aos times Comercial, Financeiro e Jurídico para garantir a formalização adequada de todos os contratos;
  • Zelar pela integridade, organização e segurança das informações contratuais, sendo o guardião do processo de formalização;
  • Participar da melhoria contínua dos processos de gestão contratual, propondo ajustes e automatizações que aumentem eficiência e rastreabilidade.
  • Avaliar preço, produto, promoção, descontos das vendas, registrando contratos fora do padrão estabelecido;
  • Resgatar informações históricas de contrato para analise de cobrança, retenção, cancelamento;

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Direito, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia com gestão, auditoria ou controle de contratos (comercial, jurídico ou administrativo);
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de gestão (ERP, CRM, financeiro) e boas práticas de versionamento e compliance documental;
  • Habilidade com planilhas e ferramentas de automação de relatórios (Google Sheets, Excel, Power BI, entre outros);
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e postura crítica frente a erros e inconsistências;
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de integração com diferentes áreas da empresa.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou prestação de serviços recorrentes;
  • Vivência com gestão de contratos digitais ;
  • Conhecimento básico em fluxos financeiros e gestão de recebíveis;
  • Perfil de auditor interno, com disciplina, senso de dono e visão de risco.

Perfil Ideal

  • Buscamos alguém metódico, proativo e criterioso, que enxerga nos detalhes o caminho para a eficiência.
  • Um profissional com mentalidade de compliance, capaz de transformar o controle de contratos em um processo sólido, rastreável e inteligente — garantindo segurança jurídica, previsibilidade financeira e suporte à tomada de decisão estratégica.

Benefícios e Remuneração:

  • Remuneração CLT + Bonus de performance da empresa.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento dentro da empresa.
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e inovador.

title: Engenheiro mecânico
description:
Mechanical Engineering

Looking for:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position

will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and

bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,

prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all

requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.

The Candidate:

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the

concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the

world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of

materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on

challenges.

The Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English

The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?

"TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you'll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You'll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you'll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.

This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package (€61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.

This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your "home office" into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.

What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Liderar o time de Marketing;

  • Acompanhamento de parcerias estratégicas e desenvolvimento contínuo de melhores práticas e inovações do mercado;
  • Gerenciamento do planejamento, junto da agência de mídia nacional, das estratégias de mídia;
  • Acompanhamento de projetos especiais focados em implementação de novas frentes de trabalho, novos veículos, desenvolvimento de treinamento e mapeamento e implementação de melhorias dentro da vertical de mídia no shopping;
  • Gerenciamento da performance de mídia paga dos programas de benefícios do shopping, envolvendo definição de objetivos, estratégia, implementação, acompanhamento, relatório de resultados e KPIs estratégicos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em em Publicidade, Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas afins;

  • Vivência em gestão de campanhas (on e off);

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
About the job

1. About Us

We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services. Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment: Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team, building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization: Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team's professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building: Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment: Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking: Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review: Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization: Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience: Proven experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods: Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing: Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development: Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience: Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Especialista Em Ia E Business Intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?

Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.

Como Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence , sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:


  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.


Requisitos e Perfil:


  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento emSQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.


Diferenciais:


  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.


Sobre a UPX:


Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Coordenador(A) De Food Safety (Temporário)
description:
About the role

Estamos buscando um(a) Coordenador(a) de Food Safety para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, garantindo a implementação e manutenção dos programas de qualidade e segurança de alimentos na fábrica. Contrato temporário de 9 meses com chance de contratação ao final do contrato.


Key responsibilities

  • Garantir a implementação e manutenção dos programas de Food Safety e Qualidade na fábrica.
  • Promover treinamentos de HACCP para equipe HACCP e demais colaboradores.
  • Coordenar o manejo integrado de pragas.
  • Elaborar, implementar e registrar treinamentos da área de qualidade para todos os colaboradores.
  • Revisar e manter todos os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) da fábrica.
  • Atuar frente às não conformidades encontradas, utilizando ferramentas como 5W2H para análise de causa raiz.
  • Coordenar auditorias internas e externas, bem como planos de ação decorrentes de auditorias, reclamações de clientes ou não conformidades.
  • Gerenciar o sistema de reclamações de clientes.
  • Liderar a equipe HACCP e revisar estudos HACCP.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas governamentais, ambientais e de segurança industrial.


Qualifications and skills

  • Formação preferencial: Engenharia de Alimentos , Química ou Farmácia .
  • Certificações: HACCP , FSSC 22000 (obrigatória).
  • Experiência com auditorias internas e externas (relacionados à qualidade e segurança de alimentos).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de causa raiz (5W2H ).
  • Domínio de SAP e Excel (planilhas de capex, budget).
  • Conhecimento em sistemas globais e protocolos internacionais.
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura de documentação técnica e protocolos globais). Espanhol será considerado diferencial.
  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade analítica.
  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com problemas e manter a calma.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de priorizar tarefas em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Visão prática: presença no chão de fábrica, não apenas atividades administrativas.


About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Engenheiro De Software Embarcado
description:
Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

· hands-on experience in Automotive ECU development and embedded software

engineering, covering complete V-model lifecycle.

· Deep technical expertise in CAN, UDS, Diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols

with proven track record in software integration and testing.

· Expertise in Embedded C/C++, CAPL, RTOS, Device Drivers, MCAL

· Understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous (CI/CD) using Jenkins, and version control

systems like Git and SVN.

· Strong understanding of ASPICE, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and Agile/Scrum development

methodologies.

· Understanding of AUTOSAR methodology

· Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities with a holistic understanding of

hardware-software co-development.

· Experienced in conducting design/code reviews, and driving technical excellence across cross-

functional teams.


Roles & Responsibilities

1. Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments). · Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar. 2. System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints. 3. Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits). 4. Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries. 6. Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?


“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."


Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer


What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code andmentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events andknowledge sessions.


This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.A. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.


This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home officesupport package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capableof defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background insoftware development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have provenexperience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions;
from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD;
technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Analista De Cobrança E Retenção
description:
Analista de Cobrança e Retenção – DS.Marketing


Como Analista de Cobrança e Retenção, você será responsável por conduzir o relacionamento com clientes em momentos críticos do ciclo, especialmente em situações de inadimplência, desalinhamento de expectativas ou perda momentânea de percepção de valor.


Seu papel é estratégico: garantir que o cliente mantenha clareza sobre seu plano de crescimento, entenda os próximos passos e execute corretamente a jornada para renovar e recomprar com previsibilidade.


Nesta função, você atuará com abordagem consultiva, combinando princípios de Customer Success, operações de cobrança, recuperação de crédito e gestão de objeções, sempre com foco na manutenção da receita e saúde da carteira.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir contatos ativos e receptivos com clientes em atraso, risco de churn ou perda de percepção de valor.
  • Identificar a causa raiz da inadimplência (financeira, técnica, operacional ou de expectativa) e propor caminhos realistas de regularização.
  • Resgatar a visão estratégica do cliente, conectando o plano contratado aos resultados esperados.
  • Estruturar negociações e acordos financeiros que permitam continuidade saudável do contrato.
  • Controlar objeções com técnica e empatia, garantindo que o cliente se sinta acompanhado e orientado.
  • Executar rotinas de cobrança consultiva, evitando processos mecânicos e focando no impacto do plano no negócio do cliente.
  • Acompanhar SLAs de contatos, follow-ups, acordos e compromissos assumidos.
  • Mapear riscos de cancelamento e agir preventivamente para evitar churn.
  • Alimentar o CRM com histórico, status, acordos e próximos passos, mantendo previsibilidade e organização.
  • Colaborar com times internos (CS, financeiro, comercial e operações) na construção de rotinas que melhorem retenção e adimplência.
  • Gerar percepções qualitativas sobre comportamento dos clientes, objeções recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no produto/atendimento.


Competências desejadas

  • Comunicação clara e empática: saber conduzir conversas difíceis sem perder a conexão.
  • Sem medo do telefone, nosso clientes quer ser ouvido! Comunicação em voz é mais eficiente!
  • Perfil consultivo: entender o contexto e orientar com visão de negócio.
  • Resiliência emocional: lidar bem com cenários críticos, objeções, frustrações e pressão.
  • Negociação e argumentação: construir acordos viáveis e sustentáveis.
  • Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.
  • Visão sistêmica: enxergar a jornada completa do cliente e o impacto da retenção na empresa.
  • Disciplina e compromisso: acompanhar pendências, prazos e acordos até a resolução.
  • Colaboração: trabalhar próximo a CS, Financeiro e Comercial para garantir resultado coletivo.


Sobre a DS.Marketing

Empresa especialista em impulsionar vendas no varejo por meio de tecnologia, dados e automação. Democratizamos o acesso ao marketing digital para o empreendor do Brasil profundo!


Modalidade de contratação: CLT

Responsabilidades

  • Auditar e revisar todos os novos contratos firmados, garantindo aderência às políticas e padrões da empresa, a auditoria não se limita somente a analise documental, mas tambem em avaliar as ligações, videos, grações e conversas de whatsapp;

  • Apontarpendências e inconformidades em tempo hábil, sinalizando responsáveis e acompanhando as correções;
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores das auditorias contratuais, apresentando análises e tendências de conformidade;
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de recebíveis derivados dos contratos , acompanhando prazos de faturamento, pagamentos e renovações;
  • Criar emanter gatilhos automáticos e reports recorrentes , com alertas sobre vencimentos, reajustes e obrigações financeiras;
  • Atuar junto aos times Comercial, Financeiro e Jurídico para garantir a formalização adequada de todos os contratos;
  • Zelar pela integridade, organização e segurança das informações contratuais , sendo o guardião do processo de formalização ;
  • Participar da melhoria contínua dos processos de gestão contratual , propondo ajustes e automatizações que aumentem eficiência e rastreabilidade.
  • Avaliar preço, produto, promoção, descontos das vendas , registrando contratos fora do padrão estabelecido;
  • Resgatar informações históricas de contrato para analise de cobrança, retenção, cancelamento;


Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Direito, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial ;
  • Experiência prévia com gestão, auditoria ou controle de contratos (comercial, jurídico ou administrativo);
  • Conhecimento desistemas de gestão (ERP, CRM, financeiro) e boas práticas de versionamento e compliance documental;
  • Habilidade com planilhas e ferramentas de automação de relatórios (Google Sheets, Excel, Power BI, entre outros);
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e postura crítica frente a erros e inconsistências;

-Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units) . · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments ).

- Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar.

-System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints.

- Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries.

- Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Engenheiro Mecânico
description:
Mechanical Engineering


Looking for:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position

will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and

bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,

prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all

requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.


The Candidate:

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the

concept to manufacturing journey. You’ve either built or supported bringing new products to the

world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of

materials. You’re willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on

challenges.

The Qualifications :

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE’s.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English


The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.E. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

description:
Vaga temporária (90 dias) com alta chance de efetivação.
Na World Wine, o Estoquista é responsável por garantir a organização, conservação e acuracidade do estoque de nossos produtos — incluindo rótulos exclusivos e de alta qualidade. Com atenção aos detalhes e zelo pelos processos, esse profissional assegura que os vinhos estejam armazenados corretamente, prontos para atender nossos clientes com excelência.

  • Controlar os estoques, verificando se há espaços vazios nas gôndolas e se o mix de produtos está completo;
  • Fazer pedido de transferência de mercadorias para reposição de loja, verificando os rótulos que estão faltando para completar o mix de produtos;
  • Verificar o recebimento de mercadorias, observando todos os itens do produto e enviar a nota fiscal ao setor administrativo para inclusão no sistema, garantindo que os produtos sejam exatamente os mesmos que entrarão no estoque da loja;
